title: Iran warns of expanded retaliation as Israel reportedly readies to attack
detail: Al Jazeera reports Iran warned of expanded retaliation while Israel is reportedly preparing an attack. Details of the warning and the reported Israeli preparations are as characterised by the outlet; not independently verified.

title: Iran unveils underground 'missile city' as military chief warns of retaliation beyond the Middle East
detail: Per an aggregated feed headline, Iran unveiled an underground 'missile city' and its military chief warned of retaliation extending beyond the Middle East. Outlet not identified; details unverified.
